main_body: A round leafy bush or canopy blob filling the whole sprite. It has no trunk and no separate front face.
top_band: none. The column through the middle shows only mottled green foliage from row 2 to row 46, with no distinct lighter top band and no step to a front face.
evidence: The whole shape is one uniform noisy foliage mass that reads as a flat top-down patch. There is no top surface above a front face, no front-edge line and no shading step below the top. The foliage is the same mottled mix of greens from top to bottom. Because no top and front are clearly separated, it fails the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The canopy uses about 4 green steps (light, mid-light, mid, dark) scattered as pixel noise. The references have clear leaf clumps with highlights on top and deep shadow underneath. The outline is a uniform near-black line around the whole silhouette, which gives the sticker look, whereas the references use dark green beside leaves. The candidate also has no trunk and no volume or light direction. Each tile carries only about 4-5 colours in a random pattern, so it is thinner than the references.
